curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain truck stopping distance, safe passing and the rear no zone.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on stopping distance, passing and following trucks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on cutting in front of and following large vehicles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover trucks on hills, wide right turns, stop lines and oncoming trucks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the right lane, wide turns, stop lines and cutting off trucks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario items on turning trucks and intersections.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain yielding to moving emergency vehicles and moving over for stopped ones.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on pulling over and the move-over law.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on moving versus stopped emergency vehicles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through what to do when an officer pulls you over.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on pulling over, hands, weapons and documents.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario items on traffic stop conduct.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain tickets, signing, searches, fleeing and reporting misconduct.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on tickets, court, searches and complaints.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on tickets and what happens after a stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the slow-moving vehicle emblem, farm equipment and animal-drawn vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the orange triangle, farm machinery and horses.
